answer: In this PoA design, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust graph, while reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life. A new identity must provide sustained, honestly validated service before its score can accumulate; a freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality, lacks trusted incoming mass, and cannot pass consensus. Even coordinated aliases remain an oasis, plume, or marble of isolated evidence rather than an influential cluster.
